title: Borrow pass with no incoming borrow
statement: For every finite bit word, the borrow pass entered with a false borrow flag returns a false final borrow flag and leaves the word unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a finite bit word
The incoming borrow flag is false
replaced:
For every bit word, the borrow pass entered with a cleared borrow flag returns a
cleared flag and leaves every bit of the word unchanged.
